IC1: Adult participants with low [OR] or intermediate-1 risk MDS
IC2: No previous treatment with hematopoietic growth factors within 3 months prior to screening
IC3: Symptomatic anemia [AND] (hemoglobin <10 g/dL) as determined by investigator
IC4: Serum erythropoietin <500 milliunits/milliliter (mU/mL) within 14 days prior to the first dose of study treatment
IC5: Require [NOT] no red blood cell transfusion or dependent on <4 units within 8 weeks prior to screening
IC6: Clinically stable for at least 1 month prior to entry into the study
IC7: For female participants of childbearing potential and male participants with partners of childbearing potential, agreement (by participants and/or partner) to use highly effective form(s) of contraception
